$comment: Triaged dependency advisories. Read scripts/dependency-audit.ts for the rule.
An entry here is a decision that the advisory does not reach anything we ship.
It is NOT a way to quiet the build: `until` expires it, and the gate fails again.
Before adding one, establish reachability rather than assuming it — for the
transformers entries below that meant reading the package's conditional exports
and grepping the web bundle, not reasoning from the package name.

allow.reason: Decompression/parse DoS. Reached only via kokoro-js > @huggingface/transformers > onnxruntime-node. The browser build resolves transformers' default (web) export condition, which stubs onnxruntime-node out; no Worker imports transformers at all. Unreachable from anything we deploy.
Infinite loop on a negative tar entry size. Same onnxruntime-node-only path as GHSA-23hp-3jrh-7fpw.
PAX size override on intermediary GNU long-path entries. Same onnxruntime-node-only path.
Process crash via PAX numeric path type confusion. Same onnxruntime-node-only path.
Uncaught exception on a NUL byte in a PAX path. Same onnxruntime-node-only path.
Uncontrolled recursion in mapHas/filesFilter. Same onnxruntime-node-only path.
4GB allocation from a crafted ZIP. Reached only via @huggingface/transformers > onnxruntime-node, which the web build stubs out. No untrusted ZIP is handed to it in any case.

Inherited libvips CVEs. A Node-only image backend of @huggingface/transformers; the string 'sharp' does not appear in dist/transformers.web.js, and image decoding in the browser goes through the platform's own decoders.
